question: To what kind of person, tested over a specific period, is this teaching to be given rather than withheld?
premises: The teaching is only to be given, not indiscriminately distributed.
It is owed to one who has prior accomplishment in the practice.
Such a person must have been tested for the course of one year.
inference: The teaching is to be given only to one previously accomplished and tested for one year.
uncertainties: The exact nature of the required test is not specified here.
plain_english: It is to be given to one who has been previously accomplished and tested for one year.
